summary: Core retries a Nex NFS/SMB mount unit that is inactive (for example after failing at boot because the file server was not ready): the one-minute worker queues a start with --no-block and Recheck starts it before verifying; an unmounted repository now reports 'remote storage is not mounted' (BUG-0190). API impact: existing contract — storage-recheck and POST /api/v1/storage/{id}/recheck keep request, response and authorization; recheck may now start the existing unchanged mount unit and uses a clearer error.

guide.reason: Storage repositories guide explains that Core retries an unmounted NFS/SMB repository about once a minute, that Recheck retries immediately, and what 'remote storage is not mounted' means. It also notes that a hand-stopped mount is started again, so detaching is how to keep a repository offline.

api.reason: API impact: existing contract. storage-recheck keeps its request, response, authorization and asynchronous result; Core may start the existing, unchanged Nex mount unit before verification, and the not-mounted error text changed. No new endpoint or field.

roadmap.reason: Reliability fix within the existing NFS/SMB repository slice.

state.reason: No new durable state; the repository registration journal and mount unit already live on Core and are unchanged by the retry.

verification.method: go test -race ./internal/vmhost -run 'RemoteMount|Recheck|StartRemoteMounts|VerifyRemoteMount' (all three new tests failed before the fix); go test -race ./internal/vmhost ./internal/agent; python3 scripts/generate_api.py --check. Native: disposable lab, SMB server stopped while Core rebooted; mount failed at boot, repository reported 'remote storage is not mounted', then recovered to healthy about 20 s after the server returned with no manual mount or Recheck.
